title: apps/dashboard test layout: golden-file conversion tests
answers: How do I run tests for apps/dashboard?
How do I regenerate golden test fixtures for dashboard conversions?
Does apps/dashboard testing need a real database?
body:
Standard *_test.go files sit alongside source (65 files), e.g. apps/dashboard/pkg/migration/conversion/v1_to_v2alpha1_test.go:TestV1ToV2alpha1.
Golden-file tests: apps/dashboard/pkg/migration/conversion/golden_test.go (TestMain, lines 12-25) checksum-validates fixtures in testdata/{input,output}/. Regenerate checksums with `REGENERATE_CHECKSUMS=true go test ...`, or via Makefile targets `generate-golden-files` / `regenerate-golden-checksums` (regexes MIGRATION_TESTS / GOLDEN_TESTS defined at apps/dashboard/Makefile:4-5).
No DB/integration build tags found in this dir — tests run purely against fixture JSON.
Run all: `go test ./apps/dashboard/...` from repo root (works via go.work). Targeted: `go test -run TestV1ToV2alpha1 ./apps/dashboard/pkg/migration/conversion/`.
